title: Get help from a person through the support portal

summary.text: Get help from a person through the support portal at https://daedalus.support.se7enlabs.com. The portal first offers approved Daedalus Wallet support guidance and can prepare a human support case if you still need help.

problem.text: A user needs help from a person and wants to know where to ask.

symptoms.text: The user cannot solve the problem with the FAQ.

daedalus.notes: Behavior read from the Daedalus 11.6.0 release notes and the 11.6.0 tag source. Check a newer release before relying on it for a later version.

causes.claim: The available evidence does not establish one cause.

resolutions.action: Get help from a person through the support portal at https://daedalus.support.se7enlabs.com.
The portal asks you to verify your email address once.

expected_outcome.text: The user follows the behavior the cited sources describe and knows where to ask for help if it does not resolve the problem.

do_not: Never disclose recovery phrases, seed words, private keys or spending passwords.
Do not delete, reset or move wallet data using generic instructions.
escalate_when: The symptom persists after the safe diagnostic steps, or funds appear at risk.

evidence.rationale: Release notes, tagged source and portal pages directly state the behavior; this is source inspection, not runtime testing.

faq.reason: Common support topic with a short answer that every cited source supports.
